correctness.rationale: Five independent left-kernel vectors prove baseline rank at most ten; independently verified integer core minor -1 gives exact rank and Smith unit factors. Any chosen subset of five distinct-row-and-column omissions produces a rank-(10+k) minor of determinant ±1 by the multilinear determinant coefficient argument; a k-entry rank update gives the reverse bound. Character orthogonality yields precisely d^(10+k) equal Schmidt values for every d≥2. Bareiss and independent bit-rank checkers pass.
